value.rationale: The graph is the line graph on 21 incidences of the smallest projective plane, a natural highly symmetric four-regular graph. The exact first post-recovery Čech transition from eight circle classes at scale two to 76 integral two-sphere classes at scale three is structurally meaningful. The pure six-dimensional non-shellable complex supplies a new sharp computational topology benchmark not reducible to elementary counting or prior scale-two theorems.
